name: hash_verify
description: Hash a text, hex bytes or a workspace file with MD5, SHA-1, SHA-2, SHA-3 or BLAKE2, or compute an HMAC with a key, and verify against an expected checksum (hex or a sha256sum line) in constant time, guessing the algorithm from the digest length. Warns when MD5 or SHA-1 is used.

hex.description: Raw bytes as hexadecimal; spaces and colons ignored

file.description: Relative path inside the working directory

hmac_key.description: Compute HMAC with this UTF-8 key

catalog.source: Python hashlib and hmac; test vectors from FIPS 180-4, FIPS 202, RFC 1321 and RFC 2104
